master_rule: The approved master is 4.5-5.5 heads tall, compact but not chibi, and consistently screen-left three-quarter from hood through shoulders, pelvis, knees, and both feet.
bind_pose_rule: Every component is extracted from the approved master and keeps its exact perspective, foreshortening, lighting direction, palette, and bind orientation; independently redesigned neutral/front-facing replacement parts are invalid.
visible_pixel_rule: Every visible attachment pixel must be copied byte-for-byte from approved_master.png through the ownership map. Generated sheets are permitted only as hidden-underlap donors beneath approved visible pixels.
render_rule: Soft hand-painted 2D game art matching the shipped Ruby Raider family; restrained values and brush texture; no faceted geometry, glossy 3D render, plastic toy surface, outline-heavy cartoon, or photoreal anatomy.
joint_rule: Visible pixels come from masks of the approved master. Only hidden joint underlaps are outpainted by 12-20 source pixels. Joint covers hide the seam. No visible hollow pipe sockets or circular plugs.

manual_checks: near/far arm and leg depth is unambiguous
strap is behind the shoulder and in front of the chest where appropriate
scarf and cloak front/back pieces never cross the face or UI incorrectly
no exposed connector plugs at bind or action extrema
